Hi Emily / Daniel -

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the POC/trial so we can align on success criteria, timelines, and ownership:

1) Success criteria (what Elmwood needs to validate)
- End-to-end inference latency: median request-to-first-token <= 250ms for typical 1k token prompts
- Throughput: sustain 60 qps of conversational traffic during peak window (burst to 120 qps)
- Cost: projected token cost per 1M tokens below the threshold we discussed (I'll attach a cost run)
- Output quality: >= 90% pass rate on your 50 canonical prompts (we'll use your eval set)
- Security controls: SOC2 evidence, VPC connectivity & audit logs available during trial

2) Evaluation plan / timeline
- Week 0 (this week): exchange access matrix + infra contact + procurement checklist (you)
- Week 1: provisioning + initial model inference smoke tests (Redwood infra lead)
- Week 2: run canonical eval set and load tests (joint)
- Week 3: tune batching/quantization profile and re-run perf tests
- Week 4: final review + decision meeting

3) Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Redwood: Marissa (eng sponsor / PS coordination), Lauren (solutions / trial operations), Dev (inference infra lead)
- Elmwood: Emily (product owner), Daniel (procurement & legal), security contact TBD

4) Immediate asks for Elmwood:
- Share the 50 canonical prompts (or a link) and initial acceptance thresholds
- Confirm security contact for SOC2/evidence requests
- Target procurement timeline (contract signature window)

I've attached a short success_criteria spreadsheet and our draft MoP. If this looks right I'll send a one-page RACI and a calendar invite for provisioning work next Tuesday.

Thanks - look forward to running this together.
